verdict.rationale: BILL's own docs cover the AP workflow alongside Spend & Expense on one API platform. They document bill creation with attached documents, AI multi-line bill coding, bill approval policies that control which bills need approval and by whom, and vendor payment by ACH, virtual card or mailed paper check, plus international payments in local currency. Missing for 10: wire is never explicitly named as a disbursement method, dedicated invoice capture (OCR/email inbox) is not documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run accounts payable in the same platform — capture invoices, route approvals, and pay vendors by ACH, check, or wire

citations.quote: access the full breadth of the BILL API Platform: AP, AR, & S&E
Use POST /v3/bills to create a bill. You can also use POST /v3/bills/bulk to create multiple bills with one request.
In addition, you can upload documents for bills.
Automatic AI multi-line bill coding with the Invoice Coding Agent
A bill approval policy is a set of rules that enables you to control which bills require approval, by whom, and when.
BILL automatically enables payments to connected vendors with ACH, virtual card, or check.
Paper check is a BILL disbursement method. BILL prints and mails checks on your behalf.
When you pay international vendors, the vendors receive funds in their international currency.
